title: Trigger: EMA 8 turn
detail: Every card setup buys a green 8 (EMA 8) turn on a closed 1-min bar, filled at the next quote (ask in, bid out).
evidence: EMA 8 already pointing the trade's way on 76% of model buys (you: 44%).

title: What you are

evidence: Median buy: QQQ 0.33 against you over 15 min, 0.50 on the wrong side of VWAP; 4.10 out of the money.

title: Your edge
detail: Small pullbacks, 0.50–1.00 from a level, pressing the same side after a win, and holding 3+ minutes.
evidence: Small pullback +$671; 0.50–1.00 from a level +$300; same side after a win +$539 (50% win); held 3–10 min +$573.

title: What breaks it
detail: Buying while the push is still going, sitting on a level, tangled EMAs, quick stop-outs, and trading after 9:00.
evidence: Hard push −$325; on a level −$372; tangled EMAs −$325; out in under 1 min −$558; after 9:00 −$338.

title: November

title: Is there a model setup today?
detail: No setup on the card is a warning, not a ban.
evidence: Your trades on mornings the model sat out: 30, +$50.

title: Am I on the model's side?
detail: Avoid trading against an open or recent card trade.
evidence: Against the model: 124 trades, −$83. Same side, near its trade: right 74% of the time.

title: Did QQQ just push hard against me?
detail: More than 0.50 in 3 min: wait for it to stop.
evidence: Hard push: 66 trades, −$325, 21% win.

title: Has one candle closed my way?
detail: Wait for the first candle out of the dip.
evidence: Candle your way +$258; candle against −$43. Model: 73% of buys.

title: Am I sitting on a level?
detail: Under 0.50 from a level: wait for the break or the reject.
evidence: On a level: 73 trades, −$372, 22% win.

title: Delta and price
detail: The model buys about 0.40 delta, about $1 out of the money.
evidence: Your median: 0.23 delta, 4.10 out. Your 0.15–0.25 delta trades +$751; 0.25–0.50 −$439.

title: Stop wide enough?
detail: A 0.10–0.20 stop gets taken almost every time; once a trade works, move the stop to breakeven.
evidence: Final stop 0.10–0.20 under the fill: 111 trades, −$1,510, 4% win. Moved to breakeven or better: 68 trades, +$1,988, 82% win. Same entries with the card's exits: +$4,691 vs your +$417.

evidence: +$96 would have been +$237.

detail: No new trades after 9:00.
evidence: After 9:00: 44 trades, −$338, 18% win.

evidence: Known; the paper log is the record.

evidence: Card only +$4,379; card + options +$7,414; with the layers +$9,554.

title: 1. Yesterday's candle
detail: Green: trap CALLS are possible today. Red: trap PUTS.
evidence: Yesterday green: 75 trades, +$12,795 as sized, 71% winners.

title: 2. The trap line
detail: Calls: yesterday's low minus $1.00. Puts: yesterday's high plus $1.00. Write it down before 6:30.
evidence: Trap zone reached by 8:30 on 22 of 76 mornings.

title: 3. Last week's candle + the gap
detail: Gap-and-go calls need a gap up of $2.50+ and last week up; puts the reverse. A $2.50 gap up against a down week = gap vs week calls.
evidence: Gap-and-go: 14 trades, +$1,194.

title: 4. News at 5:30 PT?
detail: CPI mornings have been about flat for the model.
evidence: CPI: 11 trades, +$63 as sized, 45% winners.

title: 5. Fear market?
detail: 20-day vol 26%+ or a selloff week with a 1% gap: big fish and the high-IV layer can fire at the open.
evidence: Layers: 19 trades, +$2,140.

title: 6. Nothing armed?
detail: No setup on the card means no card trade today.
evidence: That was 23 of 76 mornings.

title: Not luck: timing (Oct study)
detail: Random entry times on the same days and sides, same exits: median +$1,389 vs the model +$2,815. 1 of 300 random runs beat it.
evidence: The EMA 8 turn timing roughly doubles what the day-and-side filter alone gets.

title: Not luck: side (Oct study)
detail: Random side and time on the same days: median +$201. None of 300 beat the model.
evidence: Picking the side (trap/gap rules) is most of the edge.

title: Walk-forward (Oct study)
detail: Settings picked only on earlier months made money in the next month, and all 60 setting combinations tested were positive in both test months.
evidence: No single magic setting.

title: IV cap → high-IV layer
detail: The card keeps its 35% IV cap; since Nov 9 the high-IV layer trades the high-IV mornings with its own rules.
evidence: Layers so far: 19 trades, +$2,140.
